# TASK-165 — specification

## Scope

Essentials level: a project can be at the "essentials" level, where 15 core questions are required instead of 60 and only sections that hold one need a review. Readiness, completeness, the interview and baselines work unchanged on it, so approving a baseline still creates the tasks. The level is stored (`level`, default "complete", migration), chosen when a project is created (the dialog defaults to Essentials; the API default stays Complete) and changed in Settings; going to Complete adds the remaining requirements and loses no answer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] One stored field, one place that follows it. `Spec.level` is `essentials` or `complete` (default `complete`, so every earlier project and the example keep today's bar; migration 008 persists it). `moduleQuestions` is the only place `required` follows the level, so readiness, completeness and the interview change without knowing about it.
- [x] The 15 essentials are named once in `shared/essentials.ts`; custom questions keep the flag their author gave them.
- [x] At the essentials level only sections that hold a required question need a review.
- [x] Nothing is deleted when the level changes.
- [x] The new-project dialog defaults to Essentials; the API default stays Complete so existing callers do not change.
